'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Nick Culpepper DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Culpepper]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck name '''How does this win?'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / Yes, I Think They're Still Getting Louder]]
* '''Username:''' MacGyver221
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
